execution_policy.before_consent: Configuration, static inspection and bounded offline checks, then an explicit scoped proposal. Do not run browser tests, builds, installs or servers automatically.
execution_policy.expected_output_scope: Runtime expectations below apply only to phases the user explicitly approves. Without approval, require a useful configured/not-browser-verified summary and no heavy execution. Approval for build or cold/warm alone does not authorize mutation matrices. Missing client edges must not be patched with global source guards.
